'''Shumogi''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="JAS" /> located in the [[Shumogi system/Legends|Shumogi system]]. It was a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Shumogi was under the Empire's control and was the site of the [[Imperial Ordnance Research Facility]], at which the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Golanda]] was employed<ref name="JAS" /> at some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]'' establishes that [[Golanda]] was employed at the [[Imperial Ordnance Research Facility]] while [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] was still alive. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the latter's [[Death/Legends|death]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Shumogi was first mentioned in ''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]'', which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="JAS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Shumogi [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
